en:
## New Features

- Added NUG provider as a web search fallback, so search now tries multiple gateway channels in sequence.

## Performance

- Optimized narrator catch-up to use bounded reads that short-circuit to a full reload before loading large message payloads, reducing database load on reconnect.
- Skipped a redundant refetch on the first catch-up after switching narrators, avoiding an extra round-trip and UI flicker.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed recent tabs so opening a narrator reliably adds it to the list, and unpinned subagent tabs are trimmed first when the list is full.
- Raised the persisted recent-tab title/subtitle length limit to match the frontend, so longer titles are no longer rejected.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增 NUG provider 作为联网搜索的回退，搜索依次尝试多个网关渠道。

## 性能优化

- 优化叙述者消息追赶逻辑，改用有界读取并在加载大消息内容前短路为整页重载，降低重连时的数据库负载。
- 切换叙述者后的首次追赶不再触发冗余刷新，避免额外往返和界面闪烁。

## 修复

- 修复最近标签：打开叙述者时能可靠加入列表，列表已满时优先清理未固定的子代理标签。
- 提升最近标签标题/副标题的持久化长度上限以与前端一致，较长标题不再被拒绝。
